label: Graded-foundation controls: joint witness, descending grade, off-world ascent, gradeless rivals
paraphrase: Closed controls on finite interpretations. (1) Joint witness: in the two-world profile where the necessary root false grounds the contingent true at the actual world false, with false more in esse than true and false a cause of true's being, every ascent premise, the actual and every-world ground-cause bridges, the unrestricted Aristotelian cause principle, no infinite ascent, both foundation conditions and the existing joint premises hold, with a nonempty edge, grade and cause. (2) Descending grade: in the same profile with the reversed grade (the grounded true is more in esse than its ground), actual grounding is well-founded and the grade has no infinite ascent, but the ground is not more in esse than what it grounds. (3) Off-world ascent: with two necessary concreta and a single support edge at the non-actual world only, support ascends the grade at every world and the grade has no infinite ascent, while coverage and the one-way no-novel-edge condition fail. (4) In the rotating triangle (at t0) and the rooted pair (at false), for no respect type, comparison and respect does support between necessary concreta ascend a comparison with no infinite ascent; and in the rooted pair a necessary concretum is underived at every admitted world. Statements about these interpretations only.
